The '''Nojic system''' was located in the [[Nojic sector/Legends|Nojic sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the artifact known as the [[Nojic Beanstalk]].<ref name="TT">''[[Tyrant's Test]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Nojic Beanstalk]]|system=Nojic [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Nojic [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-9.<ref name="TEA" />
